observations.behavior: Adds a new function `find_addressed_bot_user_id` and its unit tests, and updates the classifier and its documentation to check for mentions of other bots before classifying a message. P1.F5.H2 adds the implementation; P1.F6.H1 adds tests; P1.F4.H3 adds a test asserting the classifier is skipped when another bot is tagged; P1.F1.H3 adds the call and early-return; P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks Slack user info to distinguish another bot from PostHog's own bot, returning the other bot's ID if present. This could prevent PostHog's agent from responding to messages addressed to other automation. P1.F1.H3 and P1.F4.H3 use this to skip classification and return False, avoiding unnecessary LLM calls.
